resultados.pergunta: Existem pedidos não recebidos que vão causar parada por falta de insumo nas ordens de produção?
resultados.sql: SELECT op.name AS ordem_producao, pp.default_code AS sku_material, COALESCE(pt.name ->> 'pt_BR', pt.name ->> 'en_US') AS material, sm.product_uom_qty AS quantidade_necessaria_op, po.name AS numero_pedido, rp.name AS fornecedor, (pol.product_qty - pol.qty_received) AS quantidade_pendente_pedido, po.date_planned AS data_prevista_recebimento FROM public.stock_move AS sm JOIN public.mrp_production AS op ON op.id = sm.raw_material_production_id JOIN public.product_product AS pp ON pp.id = sm.product_id JOIN public.product_template AS pt ON pt.id = pp.product_tmpl_id JOIN public.purchase_order_line AS pol ON pol.product_id = sm.product_id JOIN public.purchase_order AS po ON po.id = pol.order_id JOIN public.res_partner AS rp ON rp.id = po.partner_id WHERE sm.raw_material_production_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT sm.state IN ('assigned', 'done', 'cancel') AND op.state IN ('confirmed', 'progress', 'to_close') AND po.state IN ('purchase', 'done') AND po.receipt_status IN ('pending', 'partial') AND pol.display_type IS NULL AND pol.qty_received < pol.product_qty ORDER BY po.date_planned ASC, op.name ASC LIMIT 200
